Facebook had human contractors 'reviewing' users' Messenger voice chats

Not defending faceberg, just explaining what's going on since the title isn't accurate, and other companies do the exact same thing... The contractors don't 'review' the chats, rather, they transcribe the chat for the machine learning systems. Basically, natural language processing is actually really really hard, so they need a lot of training data (audio + text representation) to train a network. They hire pajeets ('contractor' in tech news speak means a pajeet in India making 1 cent an hour) to listen to all of the audio and transcribe the conversation for a training example. If they do review anything, it would be to just compare what was said, with what the neural net thought was said, which also needed to train the network (the output needs to be labeled to determine accuracy for the back propagation algorithm).

Review in this context doesn't mean "to determine if you said something politically incorrect", but, the system they're training will eventually be able to do that for them.

If they do review anything, it would be to just compare what was said, with what the neural net thought was said

That's all good and fine, but you'll have to excuse me if I believe it's a bit more invasive than that.
